$about: Heat haze above a hot surface. Every key here is a shader uniform except qualityMode, which picks between two shaders and rebuilds the material, and the four volume dimensions, which also scale the billboard — so everything but the quality switch lands on the next frame with nothing rebuilt. HIGH refracts the real background through one framebuffer grab shared by every heat source in the scene; LOW samples nothing and draws the same field as faint additive filaments. World position is object3d.position, not a key here. Defaults are a lava pool roughly three metres across. Tune in the lab, then paste the exported JSON back over this file.
